parameters.help_en: The name of the gateway cluster. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh: 网关集群名。长度限制1~60个字符，可以包含大小写字母，中文，数字，“.”，“_”或“-”，同时必须以大小写字母或者中文开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the gateway cluster. The description can be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 网关集群描述。长度限制0~128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The region where the gateway cluster is located. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to obtain a valid region ID

parameters.name: backend_bucket_region_id
